summary: Oma Säästöpankki Oyj provides banking services, saving and investment solutions, and financial services in Finland. The company offers current, savings, and corporate accounts; deposit guarantees; debit and credit cards; secure banking services; currency services; digital services; cash handling services; and cashier services. Its loan portfolio includes mortgages, student, home improvement, and car loans. The company also provides wealth management services and assistance with inheritance and family law matters, and payment transaction services. It serves private customers, small and medium-sized enterprises, and agriculture and forestry entrepreneurs. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Lappeenranta, Finland.
ceo: Mr. Karri  Alameri B.Sc., CEFA, M.Sc.
